Its own documentation says base_url may be used for a proxy or service emulator. validate_environment passes api_key (or None) and base_url into groq.Groq/groq.AsyncGroq and binds .chat.completions; generation then calls self.client.create(). latest_semantic_finding.inference: This official artifact narrows p1-sa-424: ChatGroq is not necessarily bound to a Groq-hosted endpoint because it explicitly supports a custom base_url/service emulator. However, ChatGroq still delegates generation through the Groq SDK chat-completions client and does not itself provide provider-free or in-process local inference. A proxy/service emulator would therefore remain a separate execution backend and cannot by itself satisfy the zero-residual-executor scheduled-Chat gate. In the prior candidate, not passing base_url explicitly does not prove Groq-hosted routing because ChatGroq can source GROQ_API_BASE from environment. The candidate's explicit settings.GROQ_API_KEY remains observed, but whether that credential can be dummy/optional for a custom emulator is not established by this artifact.
